order: Every saved record follows frozen alternating unit/pair parity, including all warmups.
speed_denominator: baseline host wall / candidate host wall; equals candidate EPS / baseline EPS because counts are exact.
memory_denominator: median candidate peak RSS / median baseline peak RSS, five measured processes per scenario.
scope: Native Mac whole-process evidence; five chosen scenarios and paired repeats provide descriptive uncertainty, no Linux/gVisor rank claim. Audit verifies saved digest maps, not rehashing all timed parquet output bytes.
future_guard_note: Benchmark checks frozen protocol/runtime/baseline/input hashes at execution. Independent audit also checks control executable hashes now; benchmark itself does not enforce its stored control hashes. No drift found.
